S.FORM: ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly a si-tung 輕軌運輸系統 nalingatuan 簡介 ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly u dingki ku sapasaungay , idaw ku nu udipay a dadan a si-tung , nika caay katatudung atu dumaan a tipid masasulaad , kapah i niculilan a dadan a muculil atu duma liwasaken a palecad muculil . ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly u mahiniay ipangiduan atu kasenun sa i cuwa ku hahalhalan a musamengmeng , u ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly anu pakaynin nu silamalay ku sausi u matanektekay cinida , , muculil tu saikelun atu mukayakay atu isasanu dadan malikaku mungangiw . . ina si-tung nida itini i tukay , u cacayay ku tipid atu adidiy a tipid ku kakacawan ngay macacelcel ku nipatahekal tu culil . u ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly hananay u tucek nu imi sa idawku malalamel a muculil kyu icelang , , sisa ayda yadah ku ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly a si-tung wiyda naming idadadanay ku han malalamel , , inai ku masacacayay u A amin a dadan , u mahiniay sa u nisangaan a madayumay ku dadan mangaleb niculi nu icelang tabaki . nika u C.B pasayni nu saculil idadan makawa sa , nika maselep tuayda .但由於C,B . nika idaw ku ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly u culil sananay kumikawaway , inai ku paculilay . . ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly a si-tung u nu dingki tu naming , yadahay nu talakaway a nisangaan tu dadan a sidingkiay a tipid a dadan . . ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly u sapisangan tu baeketay a nisanga tu kalisiw adidi' , u mahiniay anipisanga tu nipatideng a patektek nisangaan idaw ku caay lalecad ; macunus nu kapahay a niculil talakaw , yu misanga tu mahiniay adidi' caay katabaki . . ahemaway a dadan nu silamaly satabakiay kapah micukaymas 8% , saadidiay a nikalineng 20 a dadipasan , kyu u dadan anu misangan tu nikakapah a nicukaymas adidi' . . ahemaway a silamalay a dadan apuyu', macelcel atu ahemaw , hidan nu bas uku sausi a miadih , u tanayu; caay pakaala tu 15 a dadipasan anu matatules kapah makaala tu 23 a dadipasan ahebal 2.5 a dadipasan , , satanayu'ay amasakaputay nu tanayu' kitabakiyan ku 80 a dadipasan , mahida sa anu micaliway tu dadan nu silamalay a tuki sa akay tanayu', macalilaw ku muculilay nu kadideng . . ahemaway a silamalay a tipid misakalamkam tu hina talakaw tu silamalay , maydih apacubelis tu nuculil nu kasenun sananay anu mahica sa, sisa maydih tu kapahay , , micunus tu nipatucek tu 4km/h/s , nika u baeketay a silamalay a dadan satalakaway sa 3.6km/h/s,caay kawmiselepay tu ahemaway a silamalay tu bulilki hida nu i caay pakatukuh 5km/h/s mahini , u mahiniay a silamalay caay pakatukuh .加速度常可以設定到4km/h/s,而一般重鐵最高也就3.6km/h/s, 5km/h/s . ahemaway a silamalay satalakaway a duba maselep , nika caay katatudung kuselep , sen-he-say VTA ahemaway a silamalay uduba malalamel a ngatu 25-35mph(40-55km/h),tecek akitidaan 50-55mph(80-90km/h). VTA輕軌的速限混行地段25-35mph(40-55km/h),專用區段50-55mph(80-90km/h). naemekan 歷史 sayaway a ahemaway a silamalay a si-tung i 19 a siki nu teban tahekal , itawyaaya tipid nu uma kumutengtengay . katukuh 1880 a mihcaan sa , malungatu idaw ku dingkiay a ahemaway a silamalay a si-tung tahekal . . Itawya patideng tu si-tung cacay ku tipid , kamusa u dadanay a sidingkiay a kadideng . wiyda u dadan nu calaycay caay kakapah henay , nika udadan caay kakapah , kyu itawya caay kaydih kymikacaway . u basu amala nu simalay a sapaculil sa , , nu dingkiay u masacacayay u tatelungan a mapapulungay a lusid . . Itawya idaw ku tanayu'ay a ahemaway a si-tung , , tini i pay-may-cuidaw kya mahidaay u tukayay a dingkiay a tipid "Interurban" ahemaway a tipid a si-tung . . tini i ci-ya-na-ta an-ta a kitidaan , u mahiniay a si-yung sa u "milintugingay a dadan nu silamalay" . nadikuda u mahiniay a kaku nu dadan nu dingkiay a tipid tini i dipun cin-ci a kitidaan macakat tuway , i pan-sen, pan-ci, cin-ti a kusi yadahay a dadan nu silamalay nu nuayawan naming kuyda u micalapay tu si a dadan , nu pan-ciy a dingkiay a dadan katukuh ayda idaw henay mahida hena nu sayaway nadikudan sa u mahiniay a kaku alaen nu dupu a kusi mala nu kuzin a silamalay a kusi u sapi nanam . katukuh 1950 a mihcaan nadikudan , u dadan nu basu yadah tuway , ahemaway a dadan nu silamalay tadudududuc sa tastasen . . ayda cay tu kapapina ku mududucay tu nu kakawsan a dadan nu silamalay "u siyang-kang a subal u dingkiay a si-tung" , ni ka ina ahemaway a ngangan nu silamalay sa u sapatinaku acacay idaw adidi' ku cayay kalecad a si-tung . namakay 1980 a mihcaan malingatu , idaw ku duma a tukay misabaluhay pacumud tu ahemaway a silamalay a dadan a si-tung , 由1980 , ni ka ina mahiniay a si-tung micapi tu lala'ay a sapalineng nu tukay a dada nu tipid a si-tung . Ina baluhay a si-tung a cacanan mala nu aydaay tu , , atu micukaymad tu yadahay a tipid ni silamalay .以及使用多節的列車. Ina baluhan a si-tung u laad mahida u luma atu luma' maka cacay a ing-li kya idaw ku cacay a pahanhanan . duma a dadan patideng tu talakaway a dadan . . aydaay a ahemaway a dadan nu silamalay a si-tung kinacacay aca mala nu kitakit nu yadahay a tukay amanamuh micukaymas . Anu u kakawsan u baluhay aca a ahemaway a dadan nu silamalay a si-tung , papilecad han atu nu basu atu ciy-in a si-tung "BRT" idaw ku kapahay (BRT),其優點有
